review_output: {"summary":"I checked each of the six prior findings against the supplied sources. Two remain open, three are resolved and one is not applicable. No new BLOCKER. This review does not establish WP acceptance. Prior findings: (1) MAJOR, NULL order revision: not_applicable. wp20_metric_order_revision is a STRICT count(*), so it returns 0 when there are no events. The report guard sets inputOrderRevision on INSERT and raises if it is NULL or stale whenever a report enters queued, running or ready. The order-binding migration marks every legacy queued/running/ready row stale, so a claimable report always has a non-NULL value and '=' behaves like IS NOT DISTINCT FROM. (2) MINOR, budget: resolved. The first query returns only jsonb_array_length and cohortCount, reserve(rowCount+1) runs before the rows SELECT, and the unit test asserts a single query. (3) MINOR, PK-only revision race: resolved. wp20_metric_report_guard raises 'metric report input is immutable' if inputRevision changes on UPDATE, and a reused report id fails on the primary key. (4) MINOR, cohort definition: resolved with small residual risk. The registration page does not filter rows: identityCurrent=false throws identity_changed instead of dropping the row. Its only extra filter is an inner JOIN on Live, which a foreign key on the registration's live should make redundant. Both use the same vendor/live/version and [windowStartAt, windowEndAt) predicates, and buildCohort uses the same half-open window. (5) MINOR, lock hold: partially resolved. Lock wait is now bounded at 2s and execution at 5s, but validation still runs after the locks are taken, so large valid projections can time out on every attempt. The forced-timeout test has not been run. (6) NIT, isolation check: still present. Outside scope: the 20-way contention gate still fails 8 of 20 and is not waived, and the trusted coverage producer and its scheduling are not finished.","findings":[{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"(gate) Serializable contention runner","area":"acceptance gate","issue":"The original 20-way concurrent contention check still fails (8 of 20).","evidence":"Owner-reported: the 12 checks on the disposable104 migrations runner pass, then the contention test fails 8/20.
